Name: StardewUI Continued
Author: mushymato
Description:
A fork of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28870]StardewUI[/url].

It fixes some bugs:
[list=1]
[*]Certain menus not working while playing in Turkish, notably Livestock Bazaar.
[*]A performance issue when mouse is outside the bounds of the intended hover area, especially on large scrolling views.
[*]See [url=https://github.com/Mushymato/StardewUI/blob/dev-unoffical/CHANGELOG.md]https://github.com/Mushymato/StardewUI/blob/dev-unoffical/CHANGELOG.md[/url] for more.
[/list]

It also adds some new features for mods that use StardewUI:
[list=1]
[*]Lookup anything integration: set a lookup anything target on a view using attributes
[*]Stardew Access integration: set screen reader text on a view using attributes, some views have automatically populated screen reader text.
[*]See [url=https://github.com/Mushymato/StardewUI/blob/dev-unoffical/CHANGELOG.md]https://github.com/Mushymato/StardewUI/blob/dev-unoffical/CHANGELOG.md[/url] for more.
[/list]

Mods that utilize new attributes not found on the original StardewUI would require this fork and will not work with the original.
For mod authors, please use the appropriate version number in your manifest.

Source Code (of fork): [url=https://github.com/Mushymato/StardewUI]https://github.com/Mushymato/StardewUI[/url]

Detailed changelog: [url=https://github.com/Mushymato/StardewUI/blob/dev-unoffical/CHANGELOG.md]https://github.com/Mushymato/StardewUI/blob/dev-unoffical/CHANGELOG.md[/url]
